name: Theia
summary: Theia is a proposed large hybrid optical detector intended to combine the directional information of Cherenkov light with the low threshold and energy resolution of scintillation. Its broad physics case spans solar, reactor, supernova, accelerator and double-beta-decay studies.
detection_principle: Water-based liquid scintillator or tailored slow scintillator, fast photodetectors and timing/spectral separation distinguish Cherenkov and scintillation photons. The detector concepts include approximately 25- and 100-kilotonne scales; these remain proposed configurations.
